name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you face a trial of devotion and courage. It tests your resolve to protect the innocent and uphold the Light against threats such as the Defias Brotherhood.
As an Alliance member, you help uncover Defias movements and documents in Elwynn Forest. This intelligence goes to Stormwind's defenders.

aliases: where do i get tome of divinity
faq.answer: You meet Henze Faulk, who lies injured on an island in Elwynn Forest. Afterward, report to Gazin Tenorm in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
faq.q: Who is involved in this quest?

faq.answer: Henze is an ally in the paladin trials who was injured while watching Defias activity. Unable to fight, he sends you to secure proof of the brotherhood's infiltration.

Gazin Tenorm is Henze's friend and a friend of Duthorian Rall. He can be found near the altar in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He barely escaped the Defias at Heroes' Vigil and wants to know Henze is safe.
The Defias Brotherhood has positions throughout Elwynn Forest. Its rogue wizards study plans and coordinate operations, and their documents show what they intend in the region.
faq.q: Why are Defias Rogue Wizards operating on the island?

faq.answer: Heroes' Vigil is a place in Elwynn Forest threatened by Defias operations. Gazin Tenorm hopes that stopping nearby rogue wizards and taking their papers will protect it from further harm.
The Defias Script is written orders or correspondence carried by Defias Rogue Wizards. It proves their infiltration and details their immediate schemes in Elwynn Forest.

sections.body: As a paladin in training, you are being tested in Elwynn Forest. Henze was injured while watching illicit activity on an island. Help him learn how far the Defias have spread there.
sections.title: A Paladin's Trial

sections.body: Henze found Defias Rogue Wizards studying secret papers on the island, but his injuries leave him unable to fight. You are sent to defeat the rogue spellcasters and recover their script. Then bring the intelligence safely to Gazin Tenorm in Stormwind.
sections.title: Infiltrators in Elwynn

sections.body: The Defias Script confirms the brotherhood threatens nearby lands, including Heroes' Vigil. Bring the stolen intelligence to the Cathedral of Light. Your return proves your devotion to the Light and that Henze survived.
sections.title: Defending the Kingdom

summary: You are proving your devotion to the Light through a trial for Alliance paladins. After helping an injured scout in Elwynn Forest, you face Defias Rogue Wizards and seek papers that threaten the realm.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
